title.zh: SmartLingo V2 免费场景任务与独立复习
title.en: SmartLingo V2 Free scenario mission and independent review

purpose.zh: 让免费学习者完成真实生活场景中的引导练习及无提示复习，防止跳到最后一张卡片误报完成。
purpose.en: Let Free learners complete guided real-life scenario practice and an uncoached review, without falsely claiming completion by skipping to the last card.

zh: 复用现有十二个场景的双语对话、听力与三选一题库；每个任务保留最后两组未提前展示的问答作为独立复习。
完成引导问答后才开放独立复习，提交后显示引导及独立复习结果；无需开启麦克风。
en: Reuse the existing bilingual dialogue, listening, and three-choice decks for twelve scenarios, holding back the final two exchanges for an unseen independent review.
Open the independent review only after guided answers, then show guided and review results without requiring a microphone.

zh: 影响生活口语免费场景任务、任务卡片与 Free/Max 说明；不改变支付、订阅或 AI 服务配置。
en: Affects Free everyday-speaking missions, mission cards, and Free/Max copy; payment, subscriptions, and AI service configuration are unchanged.

zh: 沿用已有对话选项生成逻辑，修正跳卡、续学与完成判定；独立复习不声称正式能力测评或发音分数。
en: Reuse existing dialogue-choice generation while correcting skip, resume, and completion logic; the independent review is not presented as formal proficiency or pronunciation scoring.

zh: 完整单元测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint、构建、D1 迁移重放、敏感信息扫描与 WebKit 多尺寸布局为发布门槛；部署后复核生产场景。
en: Full unit tests, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, build, D1 migration replay, sensitive-data scan, and WebKit viewport checks gate release, followed by production scenario verification.

zh: Max 一对一角色导师及语音仍受既有开关控制；复习成绩持久保存、重试历史及普通会员完整验收留待后续独立发布。
en: The Max one-to-one role tutor and voice remain behind their existing gate; persisted review scores, retry history, and full ordinary-member acceptance require a separate release.

zh: 只复用 SmartLingo 已验证的场景数据和对话选择逻辑，不引入新供应商或跨站数据。
en: Reuse only SmartLingo's verified scenario data and dialogue-choice logic, with no new provider or cross-site data.

rollback.zh: 可回退到上一成功提交；此轮没有 D1 结构或订阅数据迁移。
rollback.en: Revert to the previous successful commit; this release has no D1 schema or subscription-data migration.
